settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person Pacific jungle realism on Guadalcanal, 1942. U.S. Marine POV, humid foliage, mud, insects, rain, river crossings, perimeter trenches and sudden distant contact. Non-graphic, no heroic posing, no FPS-game framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. POV faction remains U.S. Marines; Japanese defenders remain clearly separated in opposing jungle terrain. Use long quiet sensory beats between short bursts of movement. Weapon often slung or lowered while navigating vines, drinking, checking mud and crossing water.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person jungle reenactment with humidity, sweat, rain on sleeves, mosquitoes, mud, foliage occlusion, natural head movement and realistic sound depth.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP07 — Guadalcanal: Jungle Night
movie.storySummary: A fictional U.S. Marine patrols dense Guadalcanal jungle, crosses a stream, waits through rain, returns toward a defensive perimeter and endures a tense night before dawn.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Build immersion through heat, insects, wet fabric, jungle sound and limited visibility. No constant combat. No speech.

scenes.title: Into the Green
scenes.actionDescription: The Marine pushes broad leaves aside with one hand, rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person USMC jungle trail, wet leaves close to lens, sleeve and hand, squad ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow walking through foliage. Audio: insects, leaves, boots, breathing.

scenes.title: Mud Pull
scenes.actionDescription: He looks down and pulls one boot free with a heavy step.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy boot, brown water, roots, rifle edge off-center.
scenes.videoPrompt: Downward look and one strong pull. Audio: suction mud, insects, gear.

scenes.title: Stream Crossing
scenes.actionDescription: He steadies on a branch and steps through calf-deep water.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on branch, boots in clear-brown stream, Marines crossing ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Careful wading. Audio: water, birds, insects, breath.

scenes.title: Listen
scenes.description: The patrol freezes at a distant sound.
scenes.actionDescription: He stops completely and slowly turns toward a faint branch snap.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dense green wall, hand raised near chest, rifle lowered, no enemy visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still slow turn. Audio: insects soften, one branch snap, breath.

scenes.title: Nothing There
scenes.actionDescription: He kneels and studies wet leaves and empty undergrowth.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low jungle floor, raindrops, roots, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow low scan. Audio: insects return, drip water, breathing.

scenes.title: Rain Begins
scenes.actionDescription: He pulls helmet lower as heavy rain hits foliage.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rain streaks, wet hands and helmet rim, squad silhouettes ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rain intensifies while camera lowers. Audio: heavy rain, leaves, gear.

scenes.title: Under the Roots
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches under large roots and squeezes water from one glove.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet glove, roots, dripping mud, rifle resting nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close detail. Audio: rain, drip, breath, distant thunder-like artillery.

scenes.title: Back Toward Perimeter
scenes.actionDescription: He follows squad markers through wet brush.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet trail, simple friendly route marker, Marines ahead, rifle slung.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady rear-follow walk. Audio: rain easing, boots, insects.

scenes.title: Perimeter Trench
scenes.actionDescription: He drops into a muddy trench and rests both hands on the wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person USMC trench, muddy timber, friendly helmets nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: One drop into trench, then stillness. Audio: mud, gear, breath, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Canteen Break
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks slowly from a canteen while weapon is out of frame.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen and muddy gloves, trench wall, humid night approaching.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quiet drink and exhale. Audio: swallowing, insects, distant guns.

scenes.title: Night Watch
scenes.actionDescription: He peers over the trench into black jungle with rifle low.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dark jungle edge, faint moon haze, weapon partial-frame, no visible enemy.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow rise and hold. Audio: insects, frogs, distant surf, breath.

scenes.title: Sudden Flares
scenes.description: A flare briefly lights distant jungle.
scenes.actionDescription: He ducks lower as illumination opens across opposing jungle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person flare glow over separated enemy-side jungle, friendly trench foreground.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick duck then glance up. Audio: flare hiss, distant bursts, breath.

scenes.title: Hold Position
scenes.actionDescription: He keeps low, hands steady on rifle without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy trench lip, rifle lowered but ready, flare fading.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still tension. Audio: distant fire fades, insects return.

scenes.title: First Light
scenes.actionDescription: He looks at water pooled in trench then lifts gaze to pale sky.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person muddy water, soaked sleeves, gray dawn beyond jungle.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tilt from trench water to dawn. Audio: birds returning, drip, breath.

scenes.title: Another Patrol
scenes.actionDescription: He tightens a strap and steps out behind the same squad.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands tightening web strap, Marines leaving trench into wet morning jungle.
scenes.videoPrompt: One strap pull then forward step. Audio: gear, wet boots, insects, tired breathing. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.mainOutfit: USMC field uniform, M1 helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain U.S. Marines. Japanese defenders remain clearly separate. Preserve wetness, mud, fatigue and gear continuity.

atmosphereAssets.title: Guadalcanal Jungle
atmosphereAssets.description: Dense tropical foliage, mud, vines and limited visibility.

atmosphereAssets.title: Jungle Stream
atmosphereAssets.description: Shallow tropical stream and root shelter.

atmosphereAssets.title: Marine Perimeter
atmosphereAssets.description: Muddy U.S. trench line facing separated opposing jungle.
